events.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has released the Supervisory Data Quality Index (sDQI) for SCBs for June 2026 . It measures data quality in terms of the Accuracy, Timeliness, Completeness and Consistency in the submission of returns and microdata for supervisory assessments. The objective of sDQI is to assess the adherence to the principles enunciated in the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Supervisory Returns) Directions, 2026 and Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks - Supervisory Returns) Directions, 2026 .
